SELECT BOARD_NO AS boardNo, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
